method: Whole-file manual reading of RecoveryDlg.h/cpp,690 lines; pinned bytes verified. No GUI or recovery execution.
findings: Same-volume warning is implemented in OnRecover: canonical destination prefix compared case-insensitively with source volume GUID; explicit YES remembered once per source volume for the dialog session. This resolves the policy location left open in FAT/exFAT reviews. It is confirmation, not prohibition.

Worker previews copy only display fields under mutex; full metadata stays worker-owned until completion. Timer reads atomic done before draining queue, joins before moving completed scan and resolved paths into UI data.

Stop sets cancel and unpauses then calls CancelSynchronousIo; close while busy defers until worker completion. Destructor also cancels and joins. No bounded shutdown guarantee if underlying operation ignores cancellation.

StartWorker catches recovery failures, allocation failure and generic exceptions. Failed scans clear completed metadata and volume; cancellation preserves validated discoveries. A displayed candidate is not proof of successful recovery or complete scan.

Per-file recovery failures publish outcome and continue; cancellation breaks leaving later outcomes empty. Generic exceptions escape per-file loop into outer worker catch. Successful copies are reported without retaining returned output path in the UI outcome.

Filter uses150ms debounce, rejects invalid regex while retaining current view and disabling recovery. Full refresh preserves selection/focus/scroll by scan index; scan previews append without sorting until completion.

Pending preview/outcome vectors have no explicit memory cap; timer intervals50ms and virtual list do not bound retained scan metadata or regex execution time. Timer creation failure is not checked here.

Source enumeration queries volume metadata synchronously during dialog initialization, accepting local fixed/removable NTFS/exFAT/FAT/FAT32 volumes. Device latency and inaccessible-volume behavior remain unqualified.
limits: No same-volume confirmation, cancellation, device access, recovered output, threading/UI, filter latency or allocation-failure runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
